project 1.title: Axel Platformer
project 1.description: A 2D platformer about a character AXEL with challenging level design (My very first project), the mechanics were completely made by me, also the level designs were completely made by me.

project 2.title: Quantum Particle in a 2D box
project 2.description: A simulation for an electron (or similar particle) in a 2D Box. It plots a preset given wavefunction against itself in its fourier basis and verifies Heisenberg's uncertainity principle. it also plots parametric curve of Delta x and Delta p as the wavefunction changes.

project 3.title: Quantum Counting using Grover's algorithm and Quantum Phase Estimation
project 3.description: This project implements the Quantum Counting algorithm, combining Grover's Search with Quantum Phase Estimation to statistically estimate the number of marked items in a database.

project 4.title: Resume AI Co-Pilot
project 4.description: An intelligent, data-grounded chatbot profile that acts as an interactive career assistant with voice integration capabilities.
